releases.markdown:
### Fixed

- Swiping in the terminal now scrolls full-screen programs such as Claude Code: the swipe reaches the program as mouse wheel input or arrow keys, as in a desktop terminal, and still scrolls the local history for ordinary output. ([#151](https://github.com/pohunekd/pohunek-companion-android/issues/151))

- Capture the public screenshot set with one command ([#145](https://github.com/pohunekd/pohunek-companion-android/pull/145))
- Refuse a release tag without a valid screenshot set ([#146](https://github.com/pohunekd/pohunek-companion-android/pull/146))
- Capture the full public screenshot set ([#147](https://github.com/pohunekd/pohunek-companion-android/pull/147))
- Show the screenshot gallery in the README ([#148](https://github.com/pohunekd/pohunek-companion-android/pull/148))

- Groups from session metadata, shared with the desktop companion ([#127](https://github.com/pohunekd/pohunek-companion-android/pull/127))
- Start a session from a project template, with branch options ([#128](https://github.com/pohunekd/pohunek-companion-android/pull/128))
- Moves and group edits write companion.group, and layout.json migrates into it ([#130](https://github.com/pohunekd/pohunek-companion-android/pull/130))
- Map an unresolvable host name to ConnectionFailed with a readable message ([#132](https://github.com/pohunekd/pohunek-companion-android/pull/132))
- Run the unresolved-host test on real time ([#134](https://github.com/pohunekd/pohunek-companion-android/pull/134))
- New sessions start in their group, and sessions whose group is not shared are marked ([#133](https://github.com/pohunekd/pohunek-companion-android/pull/133))
- Long-press to reorder sessions and groups ([#136](https://github.com/pohunekd/pohunek-companion-android/pull/136))
